# vdotcalculator.live

> A lightweight, browser-based suite of free health and math calculators with no registration required.

vdotcalculator.live provides mobile-friendly tools for calculating BMI, calorie requirements, percentages, and other health metrics using WHO and CDC standards. All tools are free, require no account creation, and operate entirely in the browser.

## Key Topics

- BMI Calculator
- Calorie Calculator
- Percentage Calculator
- Body Mass Index (BMI)
- Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR)
- Ponderal Index (PI)
- Mobile-friendly
- Browser-based
- Health Assessment
- WHO Standards
- CDC Standards
- Weight Categories
- Online Tools
- Lightweight Calculator
- No Registration Required

## Core Calculators

- [BMI Calculator](https://vdotcalculator.live/bmi-calculator): BMI and Ponderal Index calculator using WHO and CDC health standards
- [Calorie Counter](https://vdotcalculator.live/calorie-counter): Calorie counter calculating BMR and daily energy requirements by activity level
- [Percentage Calculator](https://vdotcalculator.live/percentage-calculator): Free mobile-friendly percentage calculator for basic math calculations
